title: HARP Verifiable Reasoning Receipt
description: A signed record of a consequential agent action. A third party can verify the signature and the applied policy version without trusting the issuer. The receipt references digests, never raw PHI.

action.description: Action performed, in dotted form, for example denial.appeal.submitted.

actor.description: The agent that performed the action and its delegation chain.

delegation_chain.description: Ordered chain from the controlling organization down to the agent.

purpose_of_use.description: Purpose of use under which the action was taken.

inputs_digest.description: Hash of the inputs to the action, not the PHI itself, for example sha256:...

policy_applied.description: Identifier and version of the policy applied, for example policy:rcm/denials@v3.

model.description: Model identifier that produced the decision, for example rcm-reasoner@2026.06.

evidence.description: References to evidence the decision relied on. Each entry points to a source and a reference, never raw PHI.

source.description: Evidence source identifier, for example payer-policy:...

conclusion.description: The decision or outcome the agent reached.

issued_at.description: Timestamp the receipt was issued, in RFC 3339 form.

signature.description: Detached signature over the receipt contents.
